title: Analysis code: assay match matters more than architecture — a cross-context audit of sequence models for repression-domain selection
description: Analysis code for a re-analysis of two published high-throughput screens of human transcriptional repression domains (DelRosso et al. 2023, Nature; Tycko et al. 2025, Nature Biotechnology), testing whether sequence models trained on one recruitment assay (rTetR) transfer to another (dCas9/CD43), and whether motif, domain-family and promoter-robustness annotations carry predictive information beyond amino-acid composition. Includes the shared tile table and the saved per-arm results, so every reported number can be checked without retraining.
